title: Simulator Device Goes Offline
description: The entire simulated supervisory device stops responding to any BACnet traffic -- Who-Is, reads, and writes -- exactly as it would if the physical bench PC lost power or network connectivity, rather than any single point failing.

events.description: The whole device stops responding to any BACnet request

expected_results: Every WebCTRL point bound to this device shows a communication failure / stale value, not just one equipment group
WebCTRL should NOT show individual point-level errors that suggest a specific sensor or actuator problem
All points should recover cleanly once communication is restored at t+150s, with no lingering incorrect values
completion_criteria: Student recognizes this as a device-wide communication failure rather than troubleshooting individual points
Student verifies recovery by confirming ALL affected points return, not just the first one checked
instructor_notes: Good early-semester scenario for teaching students to distinguish 'one point is wrong' from 'the whole device is unreachable' before diving into point-by-point diagnosis.
student_objectives: Recognize a device-level communication failure pattern versus a point-level fault
Practice the correct triage order: confirm scope of the problem before troubleshooting specifics
